name: Gouda Tetsuya
source:
Another member of the "Filament" squad. His Cybody, Tetrioht, specializes in speed and transforms into a motorcycle. [spoiler]He was the second opponent to be defeated by Takuto. At the end of the anime, he acquires his true mark and helps Takuto.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters##Glittering_Crux_Brigade]Wikipedia[/url].]
